title: Exotic Dutch Bryndza Cheese Casserole
description: A fermented and molten Dutch dish featuring bryndza cheese, this casserole is a plant-based friendly and adventurous meal option, served in a ramekin.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until softened.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Stir in the spinach, vegetable broth, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a bowl, crumble the bryndza cheese and mix it with the simmered mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a ramekin and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with additional spinach if desired.
